entry.title: Windows 11 26H2: Sign-in and identity in the November 2026 update (33 fixes)
entry.summary: KB5132043, KB5132061, KB5135385: 33 security fixes in Sign-in and identity. Biggest parts: Windows Smart Card (6); Windows Kerberos (6); Windows Local Security Authority Subsystem Service (LSASS) (6); Active Directory Domain Services (4). Files changed (24): kerberos.dll, lsasrv.dll, msv1_0.dll, adsldpc.dll, cloudap.dll, credssp.dll, kdcpw.dll, kerbclientshared.dll….
